notes: Strip a: x 0-3030 plus ~300 px overlap (to 3330). Plate turned: Hewitt Avenue forms the upper part's west (plate) edge running SSE from the Montgomery/Woodburn junction at the top-left; Wold Avenue's north side forms the edge of the lower part; Madison Road's SW side is the plate edge along the bottom-left. Centrelines were fitted to the printed street lines (Hough-style line fits plus cross profiles), so picks are line intersections. Widths check at ~1.5 px/ft measured across the street (Fairfax 60' = 91 px, Kinney 70' = 99 px, Wold 60' = 92 px, Burke 50' = 77 px, Hewitt 60' = 91 px). Names read: Montgomery (ROAD printed further east), Hewitt Avenue, Woodburn Avenue (tab, '...URN AVE'), Holloway Avenue, Holloway Court, Hackberry Street, Fairfield Avenue, Huron, Spokane, Graydon, Bonaparte, Wold Avenue, Kinney, Fairfax, Dexter Avenue, Anwood Street, Anwood Lane, Burke, Madison Road, Cohoon Street, Cinnamon, O'Bryon, Pogue. Suffixes not printed in this strip were written as Avenue/Street by assumption: Huron, Spokane, Graydon, Bonaparte, Kinney, Fairfax, Burke -> Avenue; Cinnamon, O'Bryon -> Street; Pogue -> Avenue. Large labels 'OWL'S NEST PARK' (partly printed '...NEST PARK'), 'THE ANWOOD', 'HINES SUB.', 'WILLIAMS SUB.'(?) are subdivision/park names, not streets. Railroads none; streetcar tracks on Montgomery, Woodburn and Madison ignored.
